metadata.title: DNS Caching and TTL Behavior

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring DNS caching and TTL behavior is predictable, bounded, and consistent with platform trust and resiliency requirements.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS caches, TTL semantics, negative caching, and resolver state behavior.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines how DNS caching and TTL semantics contribute to correct, stable, and time-bounded resolution behavior.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: DNS TTL behavior implicitly relies on authoritative platform time to ensure bounded validity and freshness of cached DNS data.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for operational guidance on DNS caching behavior, TTL use, stale data risk, and recovery considerations as described in Section 6 (Operational Considerations). This guidance informs correctness and failure behavior, not performance tuning.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to Recovery objectives, emphasizing restoration of correct service behavior without cascading failure, as described in Section 3.3.

metadata.remarks: DNS Caching and TTL Behavior defines how cached DNS data is retained, refreshed, and expired to preserve correctness and trust under normal operation and failure conditions. This pattern treats TTL as a time-bounded trust guarantee rather than a performance optimization.

components.title: Positive DNS Caching
components.description: Defines how successful DNS responses are cached in a bounded and predictable manner.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Adversary-in-the-middle or cache poisoning attacks attempting to persist illegitimate DNS records.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Enforcement of TTL-based expiration to prevent use of stale or poisoned DNS entries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cached DNS data integrity and freshness are enforced through bounded TTL semantics.

components.title: Negative DNS Caching
components.description: Defines how DNS negative responses are cached to avoid amplification of failure while ensuring timely recovery.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of negative caching to suppress resolution or delay service recovery.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit bounding of negative cache lifetimes to balance stability and recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS caching behavior avoids denial-of-service amplification through bounded negative caching.

components.title: DNS Cache Divergence Control
components.description: Limits divergence between DNS caches to prevent inconsistent resolution behavior across the platform.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Infrastructure manipulation affecting resolver state consistency.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governed caching semantics to constrain divergence and ensure consistent name resolution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS cache behavior is explicitly configured and constrained to preserve platform consistency.
